content.comment_body: I'm measuring machine run time using an hours counter, but my machine operates for 24 seconds and then rests for 6 seconds. However, the hours counter only registers for 10 minutes and then stops. What could be causing this issue?

The hours counter in [product_name] only tracks completed minutes. If the machine operates for less than one minute at a time, the counter will not record these short intervals. For brief operating periods, you should implement a custom hours counter in your program.

analysis.insight_summary: A user encountered issues with the built-in hours counter in [product_name], noting that it does not record operation periods shorter than one minute. This limitation results in discrepancies between actual and recorded operating times, revealing a gap in the minute-based tracking method suitable for applications requiring more precise duration measurement.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the hours counter on [product_name] to precisely log all periods of machine operation, even those less than a minute, accommodating continuous and accurate tracking regardless of interval length.
